about: The extended NAM pack: 50 well-reviewed TONE3000 A2 captures for User IR slots 51-100, picked 2026-11-28 by downloads, favorites and comments across styles from sparkling cleans to modern metal, a few with a Klon, Tube Screamer or Fuzz Face in front. Each was checked to have A2 models; 'model' names the one used from packs that hold several.
